g.text: build SGL for target RDMA READ
Both IPUs do fabric offload only — no NVMe logic.
Pull model: the initiator sends an NVMe-oF WRITE command capsule;
the target (stock nvmet-rdma) posts an RDMA READ to pull the payload
from the initiator's registered buffer, then commits to NVMe (FUA).
No admission control — the pull is paced by ordinary flow control:
negotiated SQ depth, per-QP RDMA-read credits (IRD/ORD), and
landing-buffer availability. A busy SSD back-pressures only
